verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Grok Bot is a general autonomous agent with a cloud computer and browser that can use browser-based tools. Its documented investigation example covers internal dashboards, traces and flamegraphs. Nothing documents a deep-research mode that autonomously searches many sources and returns a report with citations. A general browsing agent is an adjacent building block, not the story's capability, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can launch a deep research run that autonomously searches many sources and returns a cited report
